checkExplanations.agents-md: Clear agent instructions prevent workflow errors and keep autonomous edits aligned with repository-specific expectations. Add AGENTS.md guidance for setup, tests, and repo-specific guardrails.
checkExplanations.root-readme: A root README is the fastest onboarding artifact for humans and agents. It should explain what the repository is for, how to get started, and how to verify changes safely.
checkExplanations.documentation: Durable documentation roots such as docs/, specs/, and prds/ keep long-form reference material discoverable instead of scattering it across ad hoc files.
checkExplanations.ubiquitous-language: A shared ubiquitous language keeps humans and agents using the same domain terms. Add a substantive root CONTEXT.md or UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md; nested copies may supplement that glossary, but copies under docs/ are ignored.
checkExplanations.design-md: A root DESIGN.md gives agents a portable visual identity — tokens plus rationale — so generated UI can follow the project's look instead of a generic default.
checkExplanations.ci-pipeline: Continuous integration catches regressions early and enforces minimum quality before changes reach shared branches. Add or tighten CI checks for lint, tests, and builds before merge.
checkExplanations.testing-provision: Automated tests reduce regression risk and make agent-driven changes safer to ship. Keep tests isolated and document exact test commands so verification is fast and consistent.
